issues.title: Multiple crashes detected in your version
issues.description:
Crash analytics identified the following issues in p82–p88:

• App list crashes with a range error during category reordering (OBTAINIUMPLUS-C)
• APK directory fails to initialize, breaking installs (OBTAINIUMPLUS-D)
• Null check crash in error reporting (OBTAINIUMPLUS-9)
• Icon update fails with an invalid bitmap size (OBTAINIUMPLUS-2)

All resolved in p89+. Updating takes ~30 seconds via the Updates tab.

issues.title: Settings page & background updates broken
issues.description:
Crash analytics detected these issues in your version (p89):

• Settings page crashes every time it is opened — a provider type mismatch makes the entire Settings section unusable (OBTAINIUMPLUS-B/G, 220+ events across 7 users)
• Background update checks silently crash — automatic updates will not run (OBTAINIUMPLUS-D, 11 events)
• Localization initialization may fail on launch (OBTAINIUMPLUS-H)

All resolved in p93. Update via the Updates tab.

issues.title: Add App menu, Settings & error handling broken
issues.description:
Crash analytics detected these issues in your version (p90–p92):

• Tapping the + (Add App) button crashes the app — the menu cannot be opened (OBTAINIUMPLUS-J, 8 events across 3 users)
• Settings page crashes on open due to a null initialization error (OBTAINIUMPLUS-K)
• Adding an app via URL crashes mid-flow (OBTAINIUMPLUS-F)
• Error notifications silently fail when context is stale (OBTAINIUMPLUS-9)

All resolved in p93. Update via the Updates tab.
